title: lodhra microcarpa
intro: Lodhra microcarpa, commonly known as Himalayan lodhra or sweet lodhra, is a plant species that belongs to the family Leguminosae. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including menstrual disorders, menopausal symptoms, and skin problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lodhra microcarpa include its ability to balance the female reproductive system, reduce pain and inflammation, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
